newsitem.title: USA: La Teko finds new gold zones in Alaska.
newsitem.headline: La Teko finds new gold zones in Alaska.

text.p: La Teko Resources Ltd said Wednesday it identified new gold geochemical anomalies its La Teko/Newmont True North joint venture property, north of Fairbanks.
The first of two new anomalies covers an area 1,600 feet long by 600 feet wide, having soil samples with maximum gold values of .22 ounces per ton.
The second is 2,000 feet long with widths from 100 to 200 feet. It yielded soil samples up to a maximum value of .26 ounces of gold per ton.
